# CHAESSI PRESET v3.8.5 · Image sizes and Reader prompt transfer

## November 23, 2026 connection and slot revision

For free slot placement, download the November 23, 2026 revisions of both Preset and Reader. An earlier build of either app can reject a request that skips a Character number.

CHAESSI PRESET 3.8.5 and Chaessi Metadata Reader 1.0.0 keep their existing version numbers. Get the revised files from each app’s official release. The Preset release body links to the revised build commit. The original v3.8.5 tag identifies the first release source.

Start the public single-file Portable first. In Reader’s running list, check the version, path and PID of the window you want. Assign fields and choose Append or Replace for each row, then choose **Send to Preset** once. Check the preview in that Preset window. If Reader covers it, switch to the receiving window using the Windows taskbar.

Select Base, existing Characters or new Character numbers within the model limit in any order. With two existing Characters, sending only to Character 5 shows empty, disabled (Off) slots 3 and 4 in the preview. **Apply to draft** applies the batch in one step. **Cancel** preserves the draft. Sending an empty string in Replace mode requires separate confirmation.

**Undo Reader transfer** reverses the changes, including new slots. Save your draft with **Save** in the workbench. Prompt transfer does not write History, generate images or call NovelAI.

[Reader installation and first-time setup](../../README.en.md#reader-setup) · [Illustrated prompt transfer guide](https://doomokddonggae.github.io/Chaessi-Preset/v3.8.5/?lang=en&chapter=reader-transfer)

## Wide and tall image sizes

Choose **Image size** at the bottom of the workbench, then **Normal** or **Large**. Check the width × height on the button and choose **Apply size**. The new Wide landscape and Tall portrait buttons are workbench shortcuts for V5 custom dimensions.

| Size | Standard landscape | Wide landscape | Standard portrait | Tall portrait | Square |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | 1216 × 832 | 1344 × 768 | 832 × 1216 | 768 × 1344 | 1024 × 1024 |
| Large | 1536 × 1024 | 1664 × 960 | 1024 × 1536 | 960 × 1664 | 1472 × 1472 |

Try Wide landscape for a group or a broad background. Tall portrait gives you more vertical space for a full-length figure. Framing depends on the prompt and the generated result. The starting size is 832 × 1216. Small, Wallpaper, Custom and width/height swap are still available. Your saved sizes, prompts and camera settings stay as you set them. Large uses more pixels and can change the cost. Check the estimate before generating.

[Image size guide](https://doomokddonggae.github.io/Chaessi-Preset/v3.8.5/?lang=en&chapter=settings)
